verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public API surface covering Catalog, Inventory, Locations, Orders, Disputes, Payouts, Terminal, Webhooks and a Sandbox for testing. It also ships official SDKs (TypeScript example calling client.payments.create), a public API specification repo, and an llms.txt index, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the API in use, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a well-known docs path (probes 404'd; the spec lives only in the GitHub repo).
